name: @autopi/desktop
description: AutoPi desktop client for autonomous work on the Pi agent runtime
author: AutoPi contributors

scripts.dev: npm run build:with-core && concurrently -k "vite --config renderer/vite.config.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron dist/electron/main.js --dev"
scripts.build: node ../../scripts/write-desktop-build-info.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config renderer/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:with-core: npm --prefix ../../packages/coding-agent run build && npm run build
